set.body:
Owner: fit/profile with model declarations. Acceptance:
- CompiledTrialLikelihood exposes local score value/gradient/symmetric Hessian, conditional readout and separate approximation/identification receipts.
- Dense oracle verifies original contrast-penalized equations, ridge-and-release, implicit solution derivatives and both criteria. Include mixed Gram products and the amplitude-readjustment Hessian term.
- Full K=I+XPX'/lambda log determinant and its first/second derivatives match independent dense covariance calculations. Preserve nuisance-error-contrast versus full-data ML distinction.
- Require constant fixed-mean rank and frozen sigma/lambda/geometry per cell; reject invalid inverses and prior/likelihood sign errors.
- Reference results have conditioning-aware abs+relative tolerances; exact derivative test failures cannot be hidden by expected-information curvature. JVM+JS portable tests.
Performance: interface permits shared preparation and bounded work; dense solver is an explicit oracle/test or capped research backend, never the default production fast path.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-08: Define compiled likelihood contract and dense score-derivative oracle
